title: Velo Client 0.9.98: Now Playing
summary: See what's playing without leaving Minecraft: a popup with the cover when the song changes, and play, skip and volume right in the R-Shift menu. Plus two launcher fixes.

blocks.text: The new **Media Player** module shows a small popup with the cover, title and artist whenever the song changes - from Spotify, YouTube Music, your browser or any other player. It uses your computer's media controls, so there's nothing to log in to.

items: **Controls in the R-Shift menu**: play / pause, previous and next, and a clean volume slider.
**Always in sync**: skip or pause on your phone, keyboard or in the app and the controls follow.
Turn it on under **Modules > Media Player** - choose where the popup shows and how long.
Launcher: your own **Velo+ Home background** no longer sometimes disappears and falls back to the island.
Launcher: sign-in codes for the Velo staff panel show up right away.
